queries_run: Graham Corporation GHM competing technology vacuum steam ejector alternative disruption 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子載明：競爭者可能開發性能更佳的新技術，若 Graham 跟不上，產品可能過時、需求下降、失去份額或面臨價格壓力（該段寫的是 bladeless mixer 產業）。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2026 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Competitors may develop new technologies or enhanced product features that outperform or otherwise diminish the attractiveness of our current offerings.

findings.claim: 10-K 載明：公司計畫把非客戶出資的新產品研發提高到營收 1%～2%，目的包括維持技術競爭優勢；FY2026 新產品研發 $1,204 千美元（總研發 $6,354 千美元）。
findings.excerpt: Going forward we expect our new product development R&D spend, that is not customer funded, to gradually increase to 1% to 2% of revenue

findings.claim: 2024 年 10 月 Graham 推出 NextGen 蒸汽噴射器噴嘴，研發測試顯示比標準噴嘴節能 5%～10%（公司自述）；搜尋未見任何取代蒸汽噴射器的替代技術報導。
findings.source: Digital Refining: Graham Corporation launches NextGen steam ejector nozzle

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋未發現液環泵等替代技術取代蒸汽噴射器的 2026 年報導；未逐字核到 NextGen 節能數字原文。

clues.claim: NextGen 噴嘴比標準噴嘴節能 5%～10%
clues.source: Business Wire Graham NextGen nozzle release
